questions.question: Which country refused entry visas to three Russian athletes scheduled to compete at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Rotterdam?
questions.explanation: Dutch authorities denied travel visas to three Russian gymnasts ahead of the global event hosted in Rotterdam.
questions.context: 2026 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships: The Netherlands denies visas to Russian artistic gymnasts Anna Kalmykova, Viktoria Listunova, and Angelina Melnikova for the world championships in Rotterdam, while four other Russian gymnasts receive permission to enter the country.

questions.story: Russo-Ukrainian war > Nord Stream pipelines sabotage
questions.question: In which country did a suspect go on trial at a regional court in Hamburg over the 2022 sabotage of the Nord Stream pipelines?
questions.explanation: A Ukrainian national accused of damaging the undersea pipelines faced legal proceedings at the Higher Regional Court in Hamburg.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian war > Nord Stream pipelines sabotage: The Ukrainian citizen accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines in 2022 faces trial at the Higher Regional Court in Hamburg, Germany,

questions.question: Archaeologists began excavating what is believed to be the world's oldest known shipwreck off the coast of which country?
questions.explanation: Dating back to between 2700 and 2400 BC, the ancient vessel was uncovered at Kekova in Turkey.
questions.context: Ancient maritime history > Kekova shipwreck: The oldest known shipwreck in the world (2700–2400 BC) is excavated in Kekova, Turkey.

questions.question: Which country saw its air pollution surge to annual record highs in October 2026 due to drifting smoke from Indonesian forest fires?
questions.explanation: Singapore registered its worst air quality readings of the year as PM2.5 levels soared from cross-border haze.
questions.context: 2026 Southeast Asian haze: Singapore records its highest air pollution level of 2026 as one-hour PM2.5 concentrations reach about 288 micrograms per cubic metre amid haze from Indonesian wildfires.

questions.question: Which South American nation established an embassy in Jerusalem while also reinstating a free trade deal with Israel?
questions.explanation: Colombia set up its new diplomatic mission in Jerusalem alongside the restoration of bilateral free trade agreements with Israel.
questions.context: Colombia–Israel relations: Colombia opens an embassy in Jerusalem and restores its free trade agreement with Israel.
